title: Hit 1.6k CCU on my Steam playtest today! Don't let the AI critics hold you back.
author: chuongcc
selftext:
Just hit a huge milestone for my game: 1,600 concurrent players in the playtest.

​I used AI to help build this game, and it is 100% disclosed on the Steam page. If you're a dev hesitating to use AI because of online backlash, stop worrying.

​Remember: Real gamers only care if the game is fun. Actual players are the ones who judge your game's worth and open their wallets, not the vocal anti-AI critics who were never going to buy your game anyway. Keep building!
